rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant stepped/courtyard mass across views, with no obvious view-to-view collisions. It responds reasonably to the parcel and keeps a clear open center, which supports the neighborhood-living brief. The main weakness is the access edge: the blue frontage line is not answered by a strongly legible public ground seam or carved entry condition, so the threshold is present but understated. The silhouette is coherent and capacity-bearing rather than arbitrary stepping, and the overall repair looks intact. Program-wise, it is plausible for a compact mixed neighborhood building, though the section could better articulate a ground-level public threshold and a stronger roof/void relationship.
